title: Double Threat Fishing Charters
specs: Often reaching weights of over 300 pounds, a Miami swordfish serves as the pinnacle of all angling accomplishments.
By day swordfish lurk in deeper water, and a bait must be sent nearly 1800' below to the waiting predators.

services.name: Half Day Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: Serious fishing on a tight schedule: a private 4-5 hour deep sea charter with the best fishing often just 3-5 miles out.

services.name: 3/4 Day Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: Our most popular trip: a private 6-7 hour deep sea charter with time to cover more water and fish multiple techniques.

services.name: Full Day Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: A private 8-9 hour deep sea charter that lets us follow the bite through the day, and summer's best trip for mahi.

services.name: Extended Full Day
services.desc: Our longest deep sea trip: 10-11 hours of tournament-pace fishing for anglers looking to put up numbers and fill the box.

services.name: Swordfishing Charter
services.desc: A specialized 10-11 hour daytime hunt for broadbill swordfish with electric reels, best for anglers ready to commit a full day to one species.

services.name: Half Day Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Our most popular inshore trip: a private 4-hour light-tackle charter on Biscayne Bay with short runs and plenty of rod-in-hand action.

services.name: Evening & Night Tarpon/Snook Fishing
services.desc: A private 4-hour evening hunt for tarpon and snook in the inlets and passes. Leave before sunset and fish under the city lights.

services.name: Full Day Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Private 8-hour light-tackle charter exploring Biscayne Bay with time for an optional bayfront lunch stop.

includes: Target species during half days include but aren't limited to sailfish, kingfish, tuna, cobia, amberjack, sharks, and more.
